note: Hand corrections for the size ruler (dev/tools/ruler.py). Per character: "scale" = draw this picture, or this whole family of pictures (the file name without its facing or frame number), at this size, when the head finder is wrong; "feet" = where the ground is down the picture (1 = bottom edge), for pictures with dust, a weapon tip or a lying body below the feet. Run 'ruler.py measure' after any change. "family" = put a picture in a family by hand when its file name does not say so.

h2.note_sonic: Roadmap 1.61 (19 Nov): Sonic Javelin's wind-up, close and release were measured by a head turned away (too small), so the ruler drew them 14 to 23 percent bigger than his Swift stance (Suleiman: too big, north-east, under Swift). Pinned so the figure is about as big as his Swift attack (7 percent over the stance, arms out): drawn area against the stance, checked on a contact sheet.

e4.note: Rabdul is bald, so the head finder has no hair to go by: every family is set by eye.

e2.note: The bull: horns and bronze confuse the head finder, so every family is set by eye.
e2.note_163: Roadmap 1.63 (19 Nov): the flame set (6.51) and the Shield Toss throw came from sheets drawn at other sizes: flame standing about 9 percent bigger than his plain look, flame battle, wind-up and strike and the throw 9 to 12 percent smaller. Set by eye on a contact sheet (helmet and shield size) and by drawn area against his plain stance.

e3.note: The archer: horns, veil and bronze confuse the head finder, so every family is set by eye. The archer_hq_* pictures are cut at the right size (make_archer_hq.py). The others are her old small pictures (standing was 112 pixels, now 300): 2.68 makes them the same size.

h4.note: Kofi is cut at the right size by make_kofi.py and make_kofi_sheets.py; nothing to rescale. His 13 Nov sheets are pinned at 1.0: the head finder is fooled by the glowing orbs and his top-knot (see make_kofi_sheets.py).
